result.summary: Found several visual issues: a loading spinner overlaid on a popular restaurant card, truncated restaurant names in the carousel, and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the food photo and suggesting incomplete content load or a stuck state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/placeholder until ready; ensure loading states do not permanently block card content.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, cutting off the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use text-overflow: ellipsis so names are readable or clearly truncated.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right edge beyond 'Healthy', which looks like a broken or incomplete control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding and clip only intentional overflow, or add fade/scroll affordance so partial empty chips are not shown.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the truncated card ('€1.90 delivery') aligns with the cut-off title and feels cramped next to the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Give carousel cards consistent right margin/padding so text and images are not flush against the viewport edge.
